tools.name: garage_list
tools.title: Garage's virtual machines
tools.description: The user's virtual machines in Garage, as a JSON list: name, mem (MB), cpus, disk and used (GB), iso, state (stopped, booting, running, stopping, paused), ssh (its port on this computer: ssh NAME reaches it) and user, and snapshots (tag, name, date, size), newest first. Use it for a VM's name before garage_power or garage_snapshot.

tools.name: garage_power
tools.title: Start or shut down a VM
tools.description: Starts a virtual machine in Garage (its window opens), or shuts it down the way its power button does: the guest gets to close its programs, which may take a while (garage_list's state goes stopping, then stopped). The user allows it on screen first.

tools.name: garage_snapshot
tools.title: Take a VM's snapshot
tools.description: Takes a snapshot of a virtual machine's disk in Garage, which the user can go back to in Garage's window. Only while the VM is stopped (garage_list's state): fails with the reason otherwise. label is the name it shows (default: Snapshot and the date). Returns vm, tag and label.

label.title: Name
label.description: What the snapshot is called in Garage, e.g. Before the upgrade
